label: EML4::NTRK3

sections.text: EML4 encodes a microtubule-associated protein with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
NTRK3 encodes TRKC, the neurotrophin-3 receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion preserves the carboxy-terminal TRK kinase domain and replaces normal receptor regulation with partner-dependent activation. EML4::NTRK3 is a reported oncogenic TRK fusion in thyroid carcinoma.

An oncogenic NTRK fusion without a known acquired TRK resistance mutation is a larotrectinib biomarker in adults and children with advanced solid tumors after progression or without satisfactory alternatives; the indication also requires metastatic disease or surgery associated with severe morbidity.
